MF Announcement #4

Created: 2026-10-20T11:07:00Z

Code Orange:
OVHcloud CLI releases on Github compromised

Greetings all node operators, please refer to the following tweet and instructions from OVH founder Octave Klaba: https://x.com/olesovhcom/status/2112225308589834260?s=20

More information provided here:
https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/hackers-hijack-five-ovhcloud-cli.html

Whilst this may not affect OVH users on Monad, please do due diligence and ensure risks are mitigated.


Many thanks,
Monad Foundation
